# Kyle Choi - Applied ML / AI Engineer

> I build ML systems end to end: a beach-health forecasting app live on the App Store with daily retraining, LLM evaluation harnesses, and credit-risk models.

## About Me
Kyle Choi is an Applied ML / AI engineer based in San Francisco. He holds a B.S. in Data Science from the University of California San Diego (June 2026), passed CFA Levels I and II (Level III result pending), and served as a sergeant in the Republic of Korea Army.

Selected work:
- Shorelife (iOS, live on the App Store since May 2026): a soft ensemble of 10 undersampled XGBoost models forecasting daily beach-bacteria exceedances across California (0.80 AUCPR on production data), FastAPI backend on Render, daily retraining through GitHub Actions since April 2026, public model-health endpoint. https://github.com/kylechoi101/surf-health
- XOXO (iOS, v1.0 in App Review): on-device generative avatars with Apple Image Playground; prompt-evaluation harness scoring mood differentiation against identity drift. Write-up: https://kylechoi101.github.io/xoxo-blog/
- Prism Data senior capstone: transformer from scratch in PyTorch for bank-transaction categorization (95% accuracy and F1); bagged-boosted XGBoost credit-risk model (0.86 ROC-AUC); local LLM agent workflow for feature hypotheses that cut manual feature work by 50%.
- "Finding Novelty in Finding Novelty": controlled experiment showing that third-person named-scholar personas overcome LLM sycophancy in methodological review.
- "Moving the Wall": coupling detection in Baduk (Go) move sequences, 5-variable conditional logit over 361 board points. https://kylechoi101.github.io/baduk/
- Cross-Market Lead-Lag Research: 13 markets, 156 directed pairs, 588 coupling analyses; negative result published. https://github.com/kylechoi101/cross-market-lag-research

## Skills
- LLM / AI engineering: eval harness design, multi-agent workflows, local LLMs, Apple Foundation Models
- ML: PyTorch, XGBoost, scikit-learn, transformers, ensembling and calibration, time-series modeling, NLP
- Product and infrastructure: FastAPI, Expo, SwiftUI, CloudKit, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Render, AWS, Firebase, Docker, D3
- Languages: Python, SQL, Swift, JavaScript, R. Spoken: Korean, English, Mandarin Chinese
